components.name: Block Aperture Identity
components.description: Reusable /blockscan-aperture.svg mark at 44px desktop and 40px mobile, paired with compact Sepolia and Testnet context while preserving the accessible BlockScan name.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Home, Accounts, NFTs, Watchlist. Neutral default borders and text; Authentic Teal identifies hover, active, and focus states.

components.name: Explorer Search
components.description: 700x58 desktop surface with neutral resting border, #08706D focus border, soft teal focus ring, a 102x48 Sidecar Yellow action, and a persistent accepted-format line.

narrative.northStar: Midnight blockchain infrastructure with teal identity and warm signal accents
narrative.overview: BlockScan is a quiet spatial explorer: a near-black environment, compact technical header, concise search hierarchy, Authentic Teal structure, Sidecar Yellow action, and unchanged colorful NFT artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic Teal identifies structure and environment.
Sidecar Yellow is reserved for the primary action.
The central hero contains one headline, one supporting sentence, search, and one accepted-format or status line.
Nine approved NFT tokens remain on desktop and six on mobile.
The approved motion system and token composition are locked.

rules.name: Teal Structure, Yellow Signal
rules.body: Use Authentic Teal for environmental identity and Sidecar Yellow for high-value interaction.

rules.name: Protected Center
rules.body: Do not add copy or decoration that competes with the concise recognition, scope, and search sequence.

rules.name: Artwork Independence
rules.body: Never tint, recolor, hue-rotate, or desaturate the supplied NFT artwork.

rules.name: Locked Motion
rules.body: Do not modify pointer normalization, camera settings, token motion, depth, positions, scales, or render-loop behavior during brand refinements.

dos: Preserve the 85/10/5 charcoal, teal, and yellow balance.
Keep the concise hero copy and neutral default search surface.
Verify desktop and mobile together after UI changes.
donts: Do not restore generic cyan or bright-blue brand accents.
Do not add yellow lighting, yellow grids, or yellow token rims.
Do not integrate this standalone prototype into production without separate approval.
